items.title: Commencement
notes:
A meeting of City Council was held at 5:37 p.m. this date, chaired by Mayor B. Vrbanovic. Notice of this meeting had been previously given to all members of Council by the City Clerk pursuant to Chapter 25 (Council Procedure) of the Municipal Code.

The meeting began with a Land Acknowledgement given by the Mayor.

items.title: Moment of Silence - Cambridge City Councillor - Donna Reid
notes: Mayor B. Vrbanovic provided details regarding Cambridge City Councillor, Donna Reid, noting some details about her achievements in her time on Cambridge City Council and led Council in a moment of silence in memory.

items.title: Disclosure of Pecuniary Interest and the General Nature Thereof
Councillor P. Singh - Item 5.2 - Fire Station Development (Land Acquisition - Section 239 (c)) on the in-camera agenda this date.
notes: Councillor P. Singh declared a pecuniary interest with Item 5.2 - Fire Station Development (Land Acquisition - Section 239 (c)) on the in-camera agenda this date as members of his family own property in the vicinity of the subject project. Accordingly, he did not participate in any discussion or voting regarding this matter

items.title: Mayoral Business and Updates - Mayor B. Vrbanovic
notes: Mayor B. Vrbanovic addressed Council related to the Strong Mayors, Building Homes Act recently expanded and effective July 1, 2023 to include the City of Kitchener as one of the 26 additional municipalities beyond the City of Toronto and Ottawa who previously were included in the legislation. Mayor B. Vrbanovic noted while the legislation provides the Mayor additional approval authorities, some of those authorities can be delegated back to staff through Mayoral Decisions. Mayor B. Vrbanovic stated the staff and Council have always had a collaborative relationship, indicating it was his intention this date to issue Mayoral Decisions to maintaining current practices for matters including but not limited to, the hiring of the Chief Administrative Officer, Corporate Leadership Team and Standing Committee structure, noting the decisions would be available for public viewing on the City's website.

items.title: Recess and Reconvene
notes: The Special Council meeting was recessed at 5:42 p.m. and re-convened at 7.21 p.m. chaired by Mayor B. Vrbanovic with all members present.

items.title: In-Camera matter 5.1 Land Acquisition - Disaster Mitigation and Adaptation Fund (Land Acquisition - Section 239 (c)), DSD-2023-331
To confirm all actions and proceedings of the Council for August 14, 2023.
Adjournment
notes: On motion the meeting adjourned at 7:23 p.m.
